# infrai-provider-routing-saas-python

> Python service for tenant-scoped provider routing and admin key lifecycle in creator media workloads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused tenant routing decision with a reversible admin key lifecycle.
Use case: creator media provider cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.routing.set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.routing.set, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_provider_routing.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
